name: HyperDX Open-Source Self-Hosted Observability
free_limit: MIT-licensed open-source HyperDX observability platform with logs, traces, metrics, errors and session replay; self-host on ClickHouse infrastructure without a HyperDX software subscription or vendor-set event quota.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires ClickHouse and other deployment components; server, storage and telemetry processing costs are not included. Managed HyperDX/ClickStack cloud plans and their free limits are separate. Review anonymized usage-data setting.
